records.name: Jewish Graduate Student Network
records.summary: A Jewish community network for graduate students and young professionals in Philadelphia, run as a program of Philly Hillel. It lists programs named Shabbat Across Philly and Philly Jewish Community, along with student associations.
records.what_you_do: Sign up for the e-newsletter and check the site for upcoming programs. The site does not say how membership works.

first_step.how: Email info@phillyhillel.org or call 267.229.1451 to ask how to get involved
first_step.basis: Sign up is an e-newsletter form, but the site does not say how membership or events work

records.notes: Site says there are no upcoming events. The only dated item is a 2022 copyright footer, which is not evidence, so probably_active rests only on a working site. Cost and membership not stated. Philly Hillel is listed in leads_only.

records.name: Temple Menorah-Keneseth Chai
records.notes: Conservative congregation in Tacony, Northeast Philadelphia, per an August 1, 2023 Jewish Exponent article. The building was sold and a day care now operates there. The article says a small group met in person once a month on a Saturday and on Zoom every other week, but gives no contact details. No current website or public contact was found, and the Federation resource page named in the input does not mention the congregation. Hidden as private because there is no public way in and the newest evidence is more than 24 months old. Recheck if a website or contact appears.

records.name: Northeast Philadelphia Community Kollel
records.summary: A Torah study center in Rhawnhurst that offers classes and weekly Torah talks to community members. It says it welcomes Jews whatever their learning, observance, or affiliation.
records.what_you_do: Attend classes, read the weekly Torah insights and newsletter, or watch recorded talks on the site.

first_step.how: Email info@northeastkollel.org to ask about classes
first_step.basis: Classes are for community members and the site welcomes Jews of any background, but the only published way in is an email

records.notes: Class days, times and street address are not on the site. Dated items are Hebrew years only (Chanukah talks listed as 5782, a Tishrei companion as 5787), so no Gregorian date was written and status is probably_active, not active. Site says it is a registered charity; the EIN is taken from the site.

records.name: Abraham Offen Mikvah of Northeast Philadelphia
records.notes: The domain northeastmikvah.org no longer serves a mikvah. When checked it showed an unrelated, age-restricted online gambling-style site in Indonesian with several outside domains. Do not link it. Recorded as not_a_group with no website. The domain's control should be checked by the reviewer.

records.name: Jewish Community Relations Council (JCRC), Jewish Federation of Greater Philadelphia
records.summary: The public affairs arm of the Jewish Federation. It speaks to government on domestic issues, Holocaust education, and Israel, and runs a center that works against antisemitism.
records.what_you_do: Sign up for the newsletter to attend programs, join a committee or task force, or travel on a mission. The site also has action alerts and a way to report antisemitism.

first_step.how: Sign up for the JCRC newsletter, or email jcrc@jewishphilly.org or call 215.832.0650
first_step.basis: Programs are announced to the newsletter list and committees are open to join, as the page describes

records.notes: Nonpartisan status is not stated on the page. The earlier agent's note called it nonpartisan advocacy, which this agent could not confirm, so please check before publishing. Its recent items are posts dated 1, 5 and 6 Oct with no year shown, so status is probably_active, not active. Closest interest tag is racial_equity; no exact tag fits. No street address on the page.

records.name: The NORC @ JFCS (Northeast NORC)
records.notes: The Federation page named in the input redirects to this JFCS page, which says the program concluded as of September 1, 2025. Hidden as defunct.

records.name: Mei Shalva (Center City Community Mikvah)
records.notes: A ritual bath facility at 509 Pine St, Philadelphia, with online appointment booking. It is a building, not a group, so it is not published as a congregation. The site describes the mikvah in development terms, so its current opening status was not verified. Its only dated item is a 2026 copyright footer, which is not evidence.

records.name: Cedar Park Presbyterian Church
records.summary: A Presbyterian church in Philadelphia whose website offers a live worship option. The site did not show service times or an address when checked.
records.what_you_do: Watch the church's live worship experience online. The site has a Contact Us page for asking about in-person worship.

first_step.how: Use the Contact Us page on the church website; no email or phone was published on the site when checked

records.notes: The only dated item is an archive entry for December 2021, with no day. No worship times, address or email on the site. Presbytery listing address, per an earlier agent's note and not verified here: 7740 Limekiln Pike, 19150. Status dormant because the newest dated evidence is more than 24 months old. Reviewer may prefer to hide it.

records.name: Jewish Federation Real Estate (JFRE)
records.summary: A membership group for real estate and related-industry professionals. Members meet at events through the year and direct gifts toward Jewish community needs in Philadelphia and Israel.
records.what_you_do: Join with an annual gift, attend member events, and take part in the group's philanthropic investments.

cost.text: Annual membership gifts: $180 or more for members 30 and under; $1,000 to $2,499 for members 31 and up. Higher levels are listed on the page.

first_step.how: Join or renew on the membership donation page, or email jfre@jewishphilly.org or call 215.832.0532
first_step.basis: A membership gift comes before member events, and attendance for non-members is not stated

records.notes: Dated items are photo captions for 2023 and 2024 only, plus undated Federation posts, so status is unknown. Schedule not stated; events are on a community calendar the page links to. Closest tag professional_associations.

records.name: NextGen (Jewish Federation of Greater Philadelphia)
records.summary: The Federation's network for adults ages 22 to 40 who want to lead and give back. It offers social events, volunteer work, and networking.
records.what_you_do: Attend social events such as a fall signature event and a spring happy hour, volunteer, and network. Leadership cohorts are also offered.

cost.text: Giving society levels: $1,000 or more a year (Ben Gurion Society) and $2,500 or more a year (Levin Society). Event costs not stated.

first_step.how: Email nextgen@jewishphilly.org or call 215.832.0515, and sign up for the newsletter to hear about events
first_step.basis: Giving levels come first for the society tiers, and sign up steps for the group are not stated

records.notes: Newest dated items are photo captions with years 2024 and 2025 and no months, so probably_active. Open_to is set to members because joining is tied to giving; the page does not say whether events are open to non-members. Dates for events are not given.

records.name: Women's Philanthropy (Jewish Federation of Greater Philadelphia)
records.summary: A Federation group for women, whatever their career or life stage. Members give, volunteer, learn, and socialize together to support Jewish life.
records.what_you_do: Browse the events list, attend gatherings to learn and socialize, and take part in volunteer and giving activities.

cost.text: Membership cost not stated. Giving levels: $1,800 a year and up (Pomegranate), and a $5,000 annual minimum gift (Lion of Judah).

first_step.how: Email womensphilanthropy@jewishphilly.org or call 215.832.0502, or browse the events list
first_step.basis: Membership sign up and event registration steps are not stated, and giving levels are listed first

records.notes: Events list has no dates on this page. Only dated items are undated Federation posts (1, 5 and 6 Oct) and a copyright footer, which is not evidence. Status probably_active rests on a working page with no dates.

records.name: Women of Vision (Jewish Federation of Greater Philadelphia)
records.summary: The Federation's affinity group for Jewish women and girls. Members pool gifts, vote each year on how the money is granted, and attend members-only events.
records.what_you_do: Give at a chosen level, vote on grants each year, and attend members-only events such as a book review and a mural tour. A women's civil rights trip is planned for spring 2027.

cost.text: Membership comes with a multi-year gift: $1,800 over two years (under 45) or $3,600 over two years (45 and over). The page lists higher levels up to $100,000.

first_step.how: Make a gift at any level (membership comes with it), or email womenofvision@jewishphilly.org or call 215.832.0841
first_step.basis: Members-only events come after a multi-year gift, so the way in costs money

records.notes: Upcoming events are listed with weekday and day but no year, plus a civil rights trip dated April 13 to 15, 2027 with registration coming soon. The group's name includes the word Foundation, but it is a Federation affinity giving circle, not a private family foundation, so it is published. Reviewer may confirm.

leads_only.note: Named as the host of the Jewish Graduate Student Network. Domain taken from the contact email on jewishgrads.org. Not fetched.

leads_only.name: Jewish Family and Children's Service of Philadelphia
leads_only.note: Runs The NORC @ JFCS, which ended September 2025 (recorded as defunct). Named on the Federation page. Not checked for other programs.

leads_only.note: X handle named on the Federation impact page. No own website was found, and the Federation short link points to a Federation page, not the group. Not checked.
